title.description: Finding title, e.g. "License check is a plaintext base64 compare".

detail.description: What was found, how it was observed, and the impact.

repro_cmd.description: Reusable command/tool call that reproduces the conclusion.

severity.description: One of: critical | high | medium | low | info. critical/high require >= 2 evidence ids.

vuln_class.description: Vulnerability class, e.g. auth-bypass / xss / license-bypass; used for dedup.

confidence.description: One of: verified | probable | unverified (default probable). unverified caps severity at medium.

cvss.description: CVSS v3 score 0-10; when supplied it overrides severity by the standard bands.

cvss_vector.description: CVSS v3.1 base vector, e.g. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H. Overrides cvss.

status.description: Initial triage state: candidate | verified | rejected | duplicate | wontfix (default verified after the gates).

negative_evidence_ids.description: Independent negative-control evidence ids; must not overlap evidence_ids.

negative_control.description: What the negative control was and why it must not reproduce the finding.

poc_id.description: PoC recipe/run id from run_poc (e.g. "sqli-boolean"); links the finding to the positive/negative evidence.
